data.comp_aggregate_note: FPI, pas de divulgation individuelle sous le droit des Iles Caimans. Verbatim Item 6.B : 'the aggregate compensation paid by us and our subsidiaries for our directors and executive officers for services in all capacities to us and our subsidiaries was $68.2 million'.
data.voting_structure_note: Classe unique d'actions ordinaires, une action = une voix. Mubadala ne dispose pas de droits de vote differencies mais controle la nomination d'une majorite d'administrateurs via le Shareholder's Agreement tant que sa participation reste superieure a 50%.
